sites.name: Godly
sites.note: 全球优秀网站灵感集，现已跳转至 recent.design
sites.analysis: 全球顶尖网页设计灵感画廊。收录大量沉浸式滚动动效、大胆的字体排版与高对比配色案例，是判断「当前网页设计风向」的标杆站点。
sites.title: Recent — Design Inspiration
sites.description: The best design inspiration on the Internet.

sites.name: Unicorn Studio
sites.note: 你给的是登录后的 dashboard，已改截公开首页
sites.analysis: 面向创意前端的 WebGL 动效工具/案例库。首页即是一组炫目的实时着色器与粒子动效，代表「生成艺术 + 交互动效」在商业网页里的最新应用方式。
sites.title: Unicorn Studio — Interactive Motion & Real-Time Graphics
sites.description: Create interactive motion and real-time graphics for the web. Stack layers on a real-time canvas, shape them with effects and motion, expose controls, and ship.

sites.name: React Bits
sites.note: 你给的是文档页，已改截首页（动画 showcase 更直观）
sites.analysis: 开源的 React 动效组件库（你项目里正在用）。首页用「实时可交互的动画组件」作为展示，代表了微交互、粒子、文字动效等 UI 细节的前沿做法。
sites.title: React Bits - Animated UI Components For React
sites.description: An open source collection of high quality, animated, interactive & fully customizable React components for building stunning, memorable user interfaces.

sites.name: React Bits Pro
sites.note: 已去掉追踪参数，改截首页
sites.analysis: React Bits 的 Pro 进阶版，提供更复杂的 3D、着色器与高级动效组件，是「商业级前端动效组件」的高质量样本。
sites.title: React Bits Pro | Animated React Components, Blocks & Templates
sites.description: 150 animated React components, 280 page blocks, 300 app UI blocks, 15 templates and an AI Agent Kit. One-time payment, lifetime updates.

sites.name: Huy Phan
sites.note: 来源：Awwwards 精选（自主搜集）
sites.analysis: 获奖设计师 Huy Phan 的个人作品集。用大胆的动效与排版呈现项目，交互细节写得克制又高级，是顶尖个人站/作品集的标杆。
sites.title: Huy Phan - Award-winning designer
sites.description: Huy Phan (Huyml) is an award-winning designer and art director based in Ho Chi Minh city, Vietnam.

sites.name: Illoca · Unseen
sites.note: 来源：Awwwards 精选（自主搜集）
sites.analysis: 英国创意技术工作室 Unseen 的建筑项目站，主打沉浸式 WebGL 与空间化叙事，代表「生成艺术 + 实时三维」在品牌官网里的前沿方向。
sites.title: illoca – Architectural design at the speed of thought
sites.description: illoca is an AI-native design engine built for professional architects. Explore, refine, and move from first ideas to editable 2D and 3D designs with more speed and control.

sites.name: Merlin Studio
sites.note: 来源：Awwwards 精选（自主搜集）
sites.analysis: 精品数字工作室官网。简洁克制的高级感设计，靠细腻的动效、字距与留白营造质感，是「少即是多」型机构站的好样本。
sites.title: A boutique digital studio turning attention into connection
sites.description: Merlin creates digital experiences that turn attention into brand connections. Building trust, shaping preference and giving a reason to act, stay or return.

sites.name: Gionatan Nese
sites.note: 来源：Awwwards 精选（自主搜集）
sites.analysis: 多学科设计师 Gionatan Nese 的个人站，实验性排版与视觉语言突破常规，体现设计师如何用网页本身作为「作品」。
sites.title: Gionatan Nese — Multi-Disciplinary Designer
sites.description: Multi-disciplinary designer based in Italy. Gionatan Nese crafts websites, brand identities, and visual experiences that leave an impression.
